in_sanskrit.name: अरध्या
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is adored and worshipped, a form of Goddess Parvati, also a name of Durga and Lakshmi.

in_hindi.name: अरध्या
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is worshipped or taught. A form of Parvati, also a name of Durga and Lakshmi.

in_tamil.name: அரத்யா
in_tamil.meaning: பேசர்கள் அல்லது வாழ்க்கை அல்லது விஷயத்தின் அடிகள்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is served or worshipped, the goddess of prosperity, or the goddess of the herbs and medicines.

in_telugu.name: ఆరధ్యా
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is worshipped or revered, a form of Parvati, also a name of Durga and Lakshmi.

in_marathi.name: Aradhyaa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Worthy of Worship
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aradhyaa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Aradhya means 'worthy of worship'. It is a revered and sacred name for a female. In Hindu mythology, Aradhya is the name of a goddess often worshipped in the form of a sacred fire.
